matrix.source_basis: TASK170 v0.7 engineering-model boundary; TASK171 reviewed R4/R5 topology and cell-compartment contracts; TASK171 implemented structural mapping invariants. Transfer is based on structural authority, not R103 synthetic outcomes.
R103 final qualification results bind [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128] to the six frozen synthetic fixtures; TASK171 explicitly leaves numeric production mesh counts unbound.
R103 final qualification results bind [3,6,12,24,48,96] as the synthetic secondary sequence only; no real-case independently mapped sequence is reviewed.
R103 frozen 64-tuple sensitivity matrix and its selected (0.01, 0.01 W, 0.01 K) tuple are synthetic-profile results; TASK171 and TASK172 leave production thresholds unbound.
R103 applies this objective only to its frozen synthetic sensitivity matrix; no real-case objective or candidate feasibility set is authority-bound.
TASK172 mesh-convergence contract §11 requires a future criterion to bind required consecutive evidence, but does not transfer R103's numeric value 2; R103's count remains fixture-specific.

R103's one-later-level rule is synthetic-only. TASK172 mesh-convergence contract §11 requires consecutive evidence but contains no headroom requirement; R104 may propose a new headroom slot, but cannot describe that slot as inherited TASK172 authority.

R103's [32,64,128,256] cap study and selected synthetic cap 128 are fixture feasibility evidence. TASK171 §resource limits classifies 4096 raw records as a structural admission safeguard, not a mesh-cell cap.
R98 independent review binds C_round=1.0 to its fixed mesh-cell-scale training/holdout scope and R103 consumes it only on frozen synthetic fixtures; no general real-case transfer is established.
R102 reviews SciPy roots_legendre order 1024 as a continuous-reference producer for frozen synthetic fixtures; it does not require an online production oracle for each real case.

R102 establishes only the measured empirical-envelope classification and its non-formal-bound limitation for frozen references; R104 explicitly leaves numeric U_Q values and any real-case reference propagation formula unbound.
TASK170 requires local wall temperatures and TASK171 binds physical wall/support identities; R103's synthetic extrema and 0.01 K threshold are not real-case expected values or acceptance limits.
TASK171 requires canonical identity/provenance and deterministic replay semantics; R103's numerical and cross-runtime observations remain limited to its six fixtures and tested runtimes.

The structural codes are present in TASK171 segmented-topology errors; mesh statuses and missing-observable/precision-floor vocabulary are present in TASK172 mesh-convergence contract §§11–12. R104 says no runtime enum is created.

notes: The headroom disposition itself remains fail-closed as ADDITIONAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED; the defect is the claim that the existing TASK172 contract requires headroom, which it does not state.
This matrix is an independent review record, not a production mesh policy or authority promotion.
